title: OPP probe police shooting
article: A team of investigators from the Ontario Provincial Police is in Corner Brook investigating the killing of a 23-year-old man.
Darryl Power was shot by a Royal Newfoundland Constabulary officer, early Monday morning. Power, who suffered from mental illness, was armed with knives and a hammer at the time of the shooting.
Police say three shots were fired by one officer.
Inspector Barry Pike is the commanding officer of the RNC in Corner Brook. He says an autopsy will be carried out Tuesday afternoon in St. John's.
Power's body remained on the ground where he was shot for more than 12 hours before it was removed last evening.
RNC officials can't say how long the OPP investigation will take.
